name: Roommate match
summary: A 6-question lifestyle quiz that ranks the group's members who are looking for a roommate.
useWhen: a housing or roommate group full of repeated 'looking for a room' posts
'anyone need a roommate', 'looking for a room in the Mission'
dontUseWhen: splitting rent in a place you already share

took.description: Members of the wider group who already took the quiz, e.g. 412

listings.description: Up to 7 members looking: name, neighborhood, a short note, and their 6 answers (0 to 2 each)

people.description: Chat members' answers so far, by name
